inputs.name: lldap_version
inputs.description: LLDAP release to install, without the leading v.

inputs.name: checksums
inputs.description: SHA-256 of the release tarball for each architecture, x86_64 and aarch64, from the release page. Change these with lldap_version.

inputs.name: base_dn
inputs.description: Base DN of the directory, such as "dc=example,dc=com". Users live under ou=people and groups under ou=groups beneath it.

inputs.name: ldap_address
inputs.description: Address the LDAP server, and LDAPS if it's on, listens on. The default keeps it to the host itself; "0.0.0.0" listens on every address.

inputs.name: http_address
inputs.description: Address the web interface listens on. The default keeps it to the host itself, for a proxy in front; "0.0.0.0" listens on every address.

inputs.name: http_port
inputs.description: Port of the web interface and its API.

inputs.name: admin_username
inputs.description: Name of the admin user LLDAP creates on its first start. It binds as uid=NAME,ou=people,BASE_DN.

inputs.name: admin_email
inputs.description: Email address of the admin user, set when LLDAP creates it.

inputs.name: admin_password
inputs.description: Password of the admin user, at least 8 characters. Pass it at run time with -var or TF_VAR_admin_password; it never reaches state or the plan. Changing it sets the new one.

inputs.name: database_url
inputs.description: PostgreSQL or MySQL URL to keep LLDAP's data in, such as "postgres://lldap:PASSWORD@127.0.0.1/lldap". The database must exist. When null, SQLite in /var/lib/lldap. It never reaches state or the plan.

inputs.name: ldaps_cert_file
inputs.description: Path on the host of a PEM certificate, with its chain, for LDAPS. With ldaps_key_file, turns LDAPS on. The lldap user must be able to read it.

inputs.name: ldaps_key_file
inputs.description: Path on the host of the PEM private key for ldaps_cert_file. The lldap user must be able to read it.

inputs.name: ldaps_port
inputs.description: Port of the LDAPS server, when it's on.
